These behaviors align with legitimate payment integration practices. There is no evidence of obfuscated code designed to inject remote scripts from attacker-controlled domains, no use of suspicious or unknown external script sources, and no attempts to exfiltrate data or manipulate system internals beyond normal SDK usage.
